scope: Still images only. Institutional customers are separately billed organizations or departments, not professor seats. Scenarios are conditional targets, not probability forecasts.

sources.title: AltContext inference cost forecast
sources.note: Measured warm A10 about 6 sec/image at $2/hour; batching remains a forecast. Does not measure the course-material workflow.

sources.title: AltContext productization launch plan
sources.note: Prior $0/$19/$49 pricing was a hypothesis. Current session changes the initial audience to professors and course materials.

sources.title: AltText.ai pricing
sources.note: Annual $49/1,200; $189/6,000; $489/24,000; $1,179/60,000; $2,199/120,000. Annual normalized rates are not monthly subscription prices.

sources.title: Altomatic pricing
sources.note: Monthly $5/500 through $200/24,000 credits. Alt text uses THREE credits/image; optimization variants use extra credits.

sources.title: ALTtext.org pricing
sources.note: Free 20/day; personal $9.99 one-time; commercial Team $19.99/month up to 5 seats; Business/API $99/month quota unspecified.

sources.title: PhotoShelter Brands plans
sources.note: Quote-based. Public plans specify 2–5 library seats and storage. User's $6k–$7k estimate is not a verified price.

sources.title: PhotoShelter AI features
sources.note: Advertises batch review of AI alt text, IPTC output, PeopleID and PlayerID. Does not prove identity is fused into each alt-text result.

sources.title: Ally AI Alt Text Assistant
sources.note: LMS-native suggestions can use surrounding rich-content/PDF text. Human review remains necessary. No standalone image price disclosed.

sources.title: YuJa enterprise pricing
sources.note: Quote-based institutional licensing and pilots; no public comparable image price.

sources.title: Panorama AI alternative text
sources.note: Extracts images from documents and generates descriptions. Vendor feature statement, not an independent quality evaluation.

sources.title: DBGallery 2025 pricing update
sources.note: AI descriptions, OCR and face recognition; 20% education/nonprofit/government discount. Current base price not recoverable from dynamic pricing page.

sources.title: Polar pricing
sources.note: Starter 5%+$0.50; Pro $20/month and 3.8%+$0.40. International-card and payout extras omitted from default base, covered by sensitivity.

sources.title: Runpod GPU pricing
sources.note: L4 Pod $0.49/hour; grouped 24 GB serverless listing $0.69/hour. Price quotes do not establish model throughput or region availability.

sources.title: Runpod Serverless billing
sources.note: Worker-start to worker-stop billing includes initialization, execution and idle time. Flex scales to zero.

sources.title: Stripe Atlas SaaS pricing
sources.note: Packaging should track customer value and salient differences. Guidance does not establish AltContext willingness to pay.

sources.title: W3C complex images
sources.note: Complex information can require a short alternative and a longer equivalent. No measured AltContext capability implied.
